messages:
Sanjay: Heads up — noticed a spike in missing spans for the /generate route since the 03:15 telemetry-policies rollout. Dashboard: https://redwood/observability/trace-views?query=route%3Dgenerate
Maria: same, most traces end at the model-proxy parent, no child decoder spans
Devon: sharing a sample trace id 0xabc123 so you can see it
Sanjay: sample trace 0xabc123 — parent present, Decoder.* child spans absent. grabbing collector logs now
observability-bot: [alert] 03:17 exporter-errors > 5/min for otlp-prod
Sanjay: logs:
```
2024-12-19T03:16:40Z warn dropped_span key-mismatch service=telemetry-collector span_id=0xdeadbeef reason="retention_label missing"
2024-12-19T03:16:41Z error exporter failed to send batch status=400 body="invalid_span_schema"
```
Maria: I spotted a config PR landed at 03:14 that touched retention labels and sampler mapping — @Devon were you the author? https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/542
Devon: yeah that was me — I renamed the label retention_label -> rl to shrink payloads. I didn't realize downstream deduper relied on the explicit field name.
Sanjay: deduper logic treats missing `retention_label` as a tombstone signal and drops subsequent children. With mixed traffic (old agents include the field, new ones don't) we hit a degeneracy.
Devon: rolling a rollback now, opening a hotfix to accept both names (retention_label || rl).
deploy-bot: rollback started: telemetry/policies 2024-12-19T03:19 -> rolling back to telemetry/policies@v2.3.0
Maria: temporary mitigation: relaxing deduper to tolerate missing label. Patch pushed to staging.
Sanjay: after rollback + deduper relaxation, dashboard traces show Decoder spans returning. Will monitor for 30m and then cut an incident postmortem.
Devon: sorry about the churn — adding a compatibility test and a deprecation window note in the PR.
observability-bot: alert resolved (exporter-errors) at 03:28
Sanjay: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
